  • TypeScript/Node.js experience, e.g. with frameworks such as NestJS

title: Personalreferent (m/w/d) Recruiting und Personalbetreuung | nördlich Braunschweig an der A2
description: Du brennst für Personalarbeit und entzündest dieses Feuer in anderen. Bei KITO arbeiten rund 80 Menschen an Sicherheitsarmaturen für den Explosionsschutz. Unsere Produkte kommen unter anderem in Tankanlagen, Rohrleitungssystemen, Biogasanlagen und Wasserstoffanwendungen zum Einsatz und leisten dort einen wichtigen Beitrag: Sie schützen Menschen und Anlagen vor Bränden und Explosionen. Lösungen entstehen durch Menschen. Deshalb wollen wir auch unsere Personalarbeit weiterentwickeln und einen HR-Bereich aufbauen, der nah an den Mitarbeitenden ist und das Wachstum von KITO unterstützt. Du willst Personalarbeit nicht nur in bestehenden Strukturen machen, sondern selbst mit aufbauen und gestalten. Recruiting bleibt dabei ein wichtiger Teil deiner Arbeit. Gleichzeitig übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt weitere HR-Themen. Aufgaben Recruiting und Personalplanung Du entwickelst die Personalplanung gemeinsam mit Geschäftsführung und Führungskräften weiter, erkennst kommende Bedarfe und leitest daraus Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Recruitingwege ab. Du steuerst das operative Recruiting von der Stellenentwicklung über Bewerberkommunikation und Gespräche bis zur Auswahl und zum Onboarding. Du entscheidest, über welche Kanäle und Wege wir die jeweiligen Zielgruppen am besten erreichen, und entwickelst Ansprache und Maßnahmen laufend weiter. Mitarbeiterbetreuung und Entwicklung Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeitenden, nimmst ihre Anliegen auf, kümmerst dich eigenständig um die Klärung und hältst die Themen verbindlich nach. Du erkennst, wo Mitarbeitende sich weiterentwickeln wollen oder sollen, stößt passende Weiterbildungen an und schärfst bestehende Instrumente pragmatisch nach. Beratung und HR-Aufbau Du baust den HR-Bereich bei KITO mit auf, bringst eigene Ideen ein, schaffst tragfähige Strukturen und Standards und treibst einfache, digitale Lösungen für die Personalarbeit voran. In Personalfragen berätst du Geschäftsführung und Führungskräfte, ordnest Situationen ein, zeigst Handlungsoptionen auf und gibst klare Empfehlungen. Kultur und Zusammenarbeit Du stärkst Wertschätzung und Vertrauen im Arbeitsalltag, förderst einen offenen und konstruktiven Umgang mit Fehlern und machst gute Arbeit sichtbar. Qualifikation Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit HR- oder Personalbezug. Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre praktische Recruiting-Erfahrung mit, idealerweise im gewerblichen oder produzierenden Umfeld. Du arbeitest strukturiert und verbindlich, übernimmst Verantwortung und behältst mehrere Themen parallel im Griff. Im Gespräch bist du klar und auf Augenhöhe, triffst bei unterschiedlichen Menschen den richtigen Ton und bleibst auch in schwierigen Situationen souverän. Pragmatisch, meinungsstark und lösungsorientiert bleibst du auch bei Gegenwind klar und handlungsfähig. Du bist neugierig und lernbereit und gehst neue Wege, digitale Tools und KI offen an. Benefits Mehr Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung: Du bekommst den Freiraum, deinen Bereich mitzugestalten, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung nach und nach auszubauen. Gezielte Entwicklung: Du musst nicht jedes HR-Thema schon können. In neue Aufgaben wächst du mit passenden Weiterbildungen und individueller externer Begleitung hinein. Gehalt, das zu deiner Erfahrung passt: Du arbeitest 40 Stunden pro Woche und verdienst je nach Erfahrung und Kompetenz 48.000 bis 55.000 Euro brutto im Jahr. Zeit für Job und Leben: Du hast 30 Tage Urlaub, kannst deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten und nach Absprache auch mobil arbeiten. Gemeinsam mehr als arbeiten: Wandertag, Sommergrillen, Weihnachtsfeier und kleinere Aktionen übers Jahr schaffen immer wieder Anlässe, auch außerhalb des Arbeitsalltags etwas zusammen zu machen. title: Führungskraft (m/w/d) Eingliederungshilfe & Soziale Teilhabe
description: Der Caritasverband Rheine e. V. sucht eine Leitung (m/w/d) der Abteilung "Arbeit, Wohnen und Teilhabe", unbefristet in Vollzeit. Die Caritas Rheine setzt sich als einer der größten Arbeitgeber der Region mit rund 50 sozialen Einrichtungen und Diensten für Menschen ein, die Unterstützung benötigen. Das umfangreiche Angebotsportfolio des Komplexträgers erstreckt sich über die Bereiche Familie, Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Gefährdeten- und Eingliederungshilfe, Hilfe für suchterkrankte sowie psychisch kranke Menschen, ambulante und stationäre Pflege sowie Migration und Integration. Insgesamt stehen rund 1.800 hauptamtliche Mitarbeitende sowie etwa 500 ehrenamtlich Engagierte den Menschen mit ihren individuellen Bedürfnissen zur Seite. Die Abteilung Arbeit, Wohnen und Teilhabe des Caritasverbandes Rheine e. V. begleitet Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Unterstützungs- oder Beratungsbedarfen. Menschen mit Behinderungen oder psychischen Erkrankungen befähigen wir, ihr Leben selbstbestimmt zu gestalten und aktiv am gesellschaftlichen Leben teilzuhaben. Mit den Caritas-Emstor-Werkstätten werden vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Teilhabe, Qualifizierung und persönlichen Entwicklung geschaffen. Im Jacob-Meyersohn-Wohnverbund unterstützen wir Menschen mit Behinderungen durch ambulante Angebote sowie in verschiedenen Wohnformen. Die Fachbereiche Ambulante Dienste und Existenzsicherung sowie Sozialpsychiatrische Dienste bieten Menschen in unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen umfassende Unterstützung. Dazu gehören unter anderem Wohnangebote in Gruppenform, Ambulant Betreutes Wohnen, psychosoziale Beratung, gesetzliche Betreuung sowie das Sozialkaufhaus. Im Haus St. Antonius in Bevergern erhalten Erwachsene mit psychischen Erkrankungen im Rahmen medizinischer Rehabilitationsmaßnahmen die Möglichkeit, neue Perspektiven zu entwickeln. Aufgaben Wirtschaftliche, konzeptionelle und fachlich-strategische Leitung der Abteilung Personalführung, Personalentwicklung und Personalsteuerung der Leitungskräfte sowie strategisches Personalmanagement für die Abteilung Gestaltung der Aufbau- und Ablauforganisation in der Abteilung Mitwirkung an Verhandlungen mit den Kostenträgern Regionale und überregionale Netzwerkarbeit Mitwirkung an Projekten und Change-Prozessen Qualifikation Studienabschluss im Sozialbereich, nach Möglichkeit mit Zusatzqualifikation auf dem Gebiet der Betriebswirtschaft oder Studienabschluss in der Betriebswirtschaft mit Zusatzqualifikation im Sozialbereich Wünschenswert sind mehrjährige Erfahrungen in leitender Funktion Erfahrung in der Organisationsentwicklung und Gestaltung von Prozessen Fachkompetenz in der Sozialwirtschaft und Kenntnisse in der Sozialgesetzgebung und dem Bundesteilhabegesetz Ausgeprägte betriebswirtschaftliche Kompetenz sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln Hohes Engagement, sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Belastbarkeit und Durchsetzungsvermögen Motivierende, teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit pragmatischer und ergebnisorientierter Herangehensweise Benefits Interessantes, abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet in verantwortungsvoller Stellung mit Gestaltungsfreiraum Strukturierte Einarbeitung und einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz bei einem zukunftsorientierten Arbeitgeber Ein erfahrenes und multiprofessionelles Team Übertarifliche Vergütung und verzinste Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (KZVK Köln) Förderung der beruflichen sowie persönlichen Weiterentwicklung Wertschätzendes und mitarbeiterorientiertes Betriebsklima Aktive Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden, Beruf und familiäre Verpflichtungen in Einklang zu bringen Flexible Mobilitätsangebote wie vergünstigtes Jobticket, Dienstrad-Leasing („caribike“) und die Möglichkeit zur Überlassung eines Dienstfahrzeugs Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement, Lebensarbeitszeitkonto sowie zahlreiche regionale und überregionale Vergünstigungen Die Caritas Rheine versteht Vielfalt als Bereicherung. Wir sind offen für Menschen verschiedener Herkunft. Wir erwarten die Identifikation mit den Zielen der Caritas. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung bis zum 02.10.2026 unter Angabe der Referenz-Nr. 23-09-26. Weitere Informationen zu dieser Vakanz erteilt Ihnen gerne die Leitung Personalwesen, Niko Keller, Telefon: 05971 862-422 Ihre Bewerbung senden Sie bitte vorzugsweise über unser Online-Formular oder per E-Mail. Aus Gründen der Nachhaltigkeit bitten wir Sie auf eine Papierbewerbung zu verzichten und unser Bewerbungsportal zu nutzen. Wir weisen ausdrücklich darauf hin, dass per Post eingesandte Bewerbungen nicht zurückgeschickt werden. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden nach Maßgabe der gesetzlichen Vorgaben bei gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung vorrangig berücksichtigt.   • Du designst, testest, wartest und verbesserst die Software fortlaufend sowohl selbstständig als auch in Deinem Team
  • Du stehst dem Produktmanagement bei technischen Fragen beratend zur Seite und besprichst Dich mit Ihnen und dem Fachbereich zu fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen und deren Umsetzung
  • Im DevOps Bereich bringst Du Dich zunehmend mitverantwortlich in Architektur, Programmierung und Tests ein
  • Durch Pair Programming, Code Reviews und Prototyping entwickelst Du nicht nur unsere Produkte, sondern auch Dich kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du tauschst Dich regelmäßig im Rahmen von „DevComs“ oder unserem Architecture Board mit unseren agilen und interdisziplinären Teams aus
  • Du schaust über den eigenen Tellerrand hinaus, verwirklichst Deine Ideen in monatlichen GreenDays und hast die Möglichkeit, diese Ideen in die Produktentwicklung einzubringen

Qualifikation

  • Als ein kreativer, analytisch denkender Kopf, hast Du Spaß an neuen Technologien und bringst ein gutes Qualitätsbewusstsein mit
  • Du lebst die Startup-Mentalität, bist motiviert und packst gerne Dinge direkt an
  • Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

  • Intensives Coaching und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie Teilnahme an der DevCom und dem Architecture-Board

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents (Bouldern, Brett- und Onlinespeielabende, etc.) und täglichen Kicker-Turnieren mit ehrgeizigen Kolleg:innen aka Kicker-Profis

  • Kulturell, sportlich sowie verkehrstechnisch sehr gut angebundene Lage

Du bist zahlenaffin, strukturiert und arbeitest eigenständig – du wartest nicht darauf, dass jemand dir sagt, was als Nächstes kommt. title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our team and culture make us unique — we’re driven by impact and growth, where every one of us strives to learn and excel. Recognised by Sifted’s Rising 100 and LinkedIn's Top Startups , we’re here to help propel your career and together, make Moss a lasting success. We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals. What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent Your responsibilities Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down. Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy. Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it. Translate customer segmentation into differentiated pricing guidance and deal strategies, partnering with Sales to get it applied in real deals, and getting it into the ruleset so it's applied consistently. Coach reps on pricing confidence and value-based selling Partner with Customer Success to adapt the pricing and deal playbook for consistency after the sale. About you Proven experience in a deal desk, pricing, commercial, revenue operations, or sales-strategy role, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech. Experience standing up or scaling a deal desk or pricing process from scratch is a plus. Strong analytical toolkit, including SQL and/or advanced spreadsheet modeling. The ability to leverage AI to build a scalable Pricing Deal Desk model, or the appetite to learn it. The direction is a low-touch desk: the agent executes the rules, its output gets better as you correct it, and each additional deal costs less human attention than the last Fluent in English; German or Dutch is a plus. In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: Comfortable holding the line with Sales on discount governance while staying a genuine partner to the team. A critical eye for AI output. The agent is sometimes confidently wrong, and catching that before a rep acts on it is part of the job. Brings commercial judgment: understands how reps sell and how price sensitivity shifts across customer segments. Structured and high-ownership, at ease in a fast, low-process, high-change environment. Able to move fluidly between detailed data analysis and higher-level strategic thinking. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 5,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, Gusto and Auto1, Moss has raised €200+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. Moss is backed by the most renowned tech investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star and Portage. We have a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities in 5 offices across Europe. Be part of a culture that thrives on impact and speed, where you can take bold moves, learn fast and accomplish more. We’re a place where you can fast track your career - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits. Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package). Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für anspruchsvolle Transformationsinitiativen – fachlich, kulturell und wirtschaftlich. Du übersetzt strategische Zielbilder in konkrete, messbare Ergebnisse und hältst Budget, Qualität und Wirkung im Blick. Du entwickelst Kundenbeziehungen strategisch weiter und baust nachhaltiges, profitables Folgegeschäft auf. Du analysierst komplexe Situationen strukturiert und entwickelst daraus tragfähige, individuelle Lösungen. Du trittst souverän auf, überzeugst auf allen Ebenen und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch. Auch bei Widerstand bleibst du klar und standhaft. Du verbindest Durchsetzungsstärke mit Empathie und gewinnst Menschen für Veränderung. Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen oder SAFe ist von Vorteil. Du übernimmst unternehmerische Verantwortung und bringst komplexe Digitalisierungsprojekte konsequent zu messbaren Ergebnissen. Du bist bereit, abhängig vom Kundenprojekt regelmäßig vor Ort zu arbeiten und die dafür notwendige Reisetätigkeit zu übernehmen. Das kannst du von uns erwarten Kultur und Zusammenhalt Bei MEONDI erwartet dich eine Kultur geprägt von Offenheit, Transparenz und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe. Eigenverantwortung & Vertrauen Du erhältst den Freiraum, deine Aufgaben selbstständig zu gestalten. Wir setzen auf Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement und auf Ergebnisorientierung statt Präsenzkultur. Flexibilität & Arbeitsmodell Mobile Working ist bei uns gelebte Realität. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub ermöglichen dir, Beruf und Leben in Einklang zu bringen – ob remote, in einem unserer Hubs oder beim Kunden. Professionelle Rahmenbedingungen & Benefits Wir statten dich mit hochwertiger technischer Ausstattung (MacBook, iPhone auch privat nutzbar) aus und schaffen klare, professionelle Projektstrukturen. Weiterentwicklung & Wachstum Individuelles Coaching, regelmäßige Austauschformate und transparente Quartalsmeetings mit Einblick in Strategie und Unternehmensentwicklung sorgen dafür, dass du fachlich wie persönlich wachsen kannst.   • Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kunden bei technischen und anwendungsbezogenen Fragen rund um unsere Pflegesoftware – telefonisch und per E-Mail.

  • Du dokumentierst Anfragen und Lösungen sorgfältig in unserem Ticketsystem.

  • Berufserfahrung im telefonischen Kundensupport, idealerweise im IT-/Softwareumfeld.

Deine Benefits

  • Einstieg in ein zukunftsorientiertes Unternehmen im spannenden Healthcare-SaaS Umfeld

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our award-winning Data Science team at a pivotal moment. Carwow operates a two-sided marketplace — connecting car buyers and sellers at scale — and data science sits at the heart of how we make that marketplace smarter, faster, and more valuable for everyone in it. In fact, we recently won GenAI initiative of the Year at the British Data Awards. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role working centrally across the business. You'll partner with teams spanning Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations — developing and deploying ML and AI solutions that drive outcomes across both sides of our marketplace. The problems you'll work on are genuinely varied: pricing models, propensity and demand signals that sharpen marketing spend, personalised recommendations for our web product and CRM, and LLM-powered solutions for operational challenges like document verification. You'll translate ambiguous business problems into structured, production-ready solutions — and you'll be expected to deliver them end-to-end, from first principles through to being deployment-ready and beyond. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING End-to-End ML & AI Delivery: Lead data science initiatives from problem framing through to deployment, monitoring, and iteration — delivering the full production lifecycle. With no dedicated ML engineering function, you'll be responsible for ensuring your solutions are robust, scalable, and performing in the real world long after they ship. GenAI & LLM Application: Design and build LLM-powered solutions where they create genuine business value — document processing, intelligent search, content understanding, and beyond. Apply them alongside classical ML with clear judgement about where each approach earns its place. Commercial Impact: Connect your work directly to business outcomes. Whether you're building a model to improve marketing efficiency, a pricing signal to sharpen commercial decisions, or a recommendation engine to increase conversion — you understand the business lever you're pulling and design your solutions accordingly. Prototyping & Experimentation: Move fast to test ideas before committing to full-scale development. Define rigorous success metrics upfront, validate honestly, and know when to double down and when to walk away. Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations stakeholders to understand problems deeply before reaching for a solution. Translate findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences. Standards & Craft: Contribute to shared best practices, documentation, and ways of working that raise the bar for the data science function — and help more junior team members grow alongside you. Drive continued adoption of AI capabilities to drive efficiencies, automation and constantly leverage new capabilities. WHAT YOU'LL NEED Please note: We know that no candidate will be the perfect match for all we've listed in this posting, so we’d encourage you to apply if you feel you're close to the brief but not an exact match. Ideally you’ll have Commercial Mindset: You think about business impact first. You understand how your models connect to revenue, efficiency, or customer outcomes — and you use that to prioritise, scope, and communicate your work. Stakeholder Partnership: Proven ability to work with commercial, marketing, and product stakeholders — translating business problems into well-scoped solutions and communicating technical solutions, challenges and outcomes clearly at all levels. Sound Judgement: You navigate the tooling landscape with clear eyes — knowing when classical ML is right, when GenAI unlocks something new, and when a simpler solution is the more honest answer. Strong instincts for scalability, reliability, and explainability. [Bonus] Marketplace or Two-Sided Platform Experience: Understanding of supply/demand dynamics and how data science creates leverage in a marketplace context. TEHCNICAL SKILLSET Proven ML Experience: A strong track record of building, deploying, and maintaining ML models in Python in a production environment — not just notebooks. You've owned models after they ship and know how to keep them healthy. Full-Lifecycle Delivery (MLOps): Comfortable delivering the end-to-end production lifecycle — model training, versioning, monitoring, and champion/challenger experimentation — without relying on a dedicated ML engineering team to carry that responsibility. GenAI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You understand how to apply, evaluate, and extend these tools — and you're honest about where they fall short. Technical Depth: Solid experience in a cloud ML environment with software engineering principles — version control, code reviews, unit testing, and familiarity with containerisation. Quantitative Rigour: Strong foundation in statistical evaluation and experiment design. You can define and defend success metrics, and you know when a model is degrading and what to do about it. [Bonus] Experience with VertexAI TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES Languages: Python, SQL Data & Transformation: dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery Visualisation & BI: Looker Engineering & MLOps: Docker, GitHub Workflow & Orchestration: Vertex AI Pipelines (GCP), Kubeflow LLMs & GenAI: Gemini API, Claude API INTERVIEW PROCESS Step 1: People Team Screening Call (30 min) Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min) Step 3: Technical Task: covering both Modelling & Production with Presentation (60 min + Task) Step 4: Values Interview (45 min) WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Hybrid working Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement Share options - when we thrive, so do you! For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year Work from abroad for a month Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for Refer a friend, get paid. "As a Senior Account Manager, you will be part of an international team of fun colleagues based in London, Boston, Bordeaux, and Paris. title: Senior Lead, Government Innovation and Economic Growth
description: The Role's Purpose Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact. The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners. Based in the North West, the role will help position Plexal at the forefront of the UK's evolving government and innovation landscape. As government influence, investment and decision-making become increasingly distributed beyond Whitehall, the role will help Plexal identify and capitalise on emerging opportunities across government, economic growth, public sector reform, innovation adoption and place-based investment. The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth. This is a hands-on commercial leadership role combining business development, strategic relationship management, proposition development and opportunity leadership, while also acting as a senior advisor to the wider GTM and leadership teams. What You'll Do Government Growth & Opportunity Leadership Identify, prioritise and lead the pursuit of high-value opportunities across UK government. Build and maintain senior relationships across government departments, agencies, arm's-length bodies and wider public sector organisations. Shape early-stage opportunities by aligning customer priorities, policy developments and commercial propositions. Lead complex multi-stakeholder pursuits from early engagement through to contract award. Navigate government procurement and commercial environments, ensuring Plexal is well positioned to maximise success. Develop and maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, funding mechanisms and investment strategies to identify future opportunities ahead of formal procurement. raw.description:
The Role's Purpose

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact.
 
The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners.
 
Based in the North West, the role will help position Plexal at the forefront of the UK's evolving government and innovation landscape. As government influence, investment and decision-making become increasingly distributed beyond Whitehall, the role will help Plexal identify and capitalise on emerging opportunities across government, economic growth, public sector reform, innovation adoption and place-based investment.
 
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.
 
This is a hands-on commercial leadership role combining business development, strategic relationship management, proposition development and opportunity leadership, while also acting as a senior advisor to the wider GTM and leadership teams.


What You'll Do

  • Government Growth & Opportunity Leadership
    • Identify, prioritise and lead the pursuit of high-value opportunities across UK government. 
    • Build and maintain senior relationships across government departments, agencies, arm's-length bodies and wider public sector organisations. 
    • Shape early-stage opportunities by aligning customer priorities, policy developments and commercial propositions. 
    • Lead complex multi-stakeholder pursuits from early engagement through to contract award. 
    • Navigate government procurement and commercial environments, ensuring Plexal is well positioned to maximise success. 
    • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, funding mechanisms and investment strategies to identify future opportunities ahead of formal procurement.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning
    • Develop deep insight into emerging government priorities including economic growth, innovation adoption, AI, cyber resilience, public sector reform, science and technology, and place-based investment. 
    • Translate policy, market and customer insight into actionable growth opportunities for Plexal. 
    • Help shape Plexal's understanding of where government priorities, investment and demand are evolving. 
    • Identify emerging markets, funding streams and policy-driven opportunities that align with Plexal's strategic objectives. 
    • Position Plexal as a trusted partner capable of helping government translate ambition into adoption and measurable impact.
  • Cross-Government Go-To-Market Leadership
    • Shape and co-own Plexal's cross-government go-to-market strategy. 
    • Identify priority growth areas, departments and opportunity themes aligned to Plexal's strengths. 
    • Support the development and refinement of propositions that respond to changing government needs. 
    • Build repeatable approaches to opportunity identification, qualification and pursuit. 
    • Strengthen commercial discipline and opportunity management across the organisation. 
    • Support the creation of scalable propositions that can be applied across multiple government customers and sectors.
  • Strategic Relationship Management & Ecosystem Development
    • Act as a senior external representative for Plexal across government, industry and innovation ecosystem engagements. 
    • Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, policy makers, commercial stakeholders and delivery partners. 
    • Establish Plexal as a credible voice within conversations around innovation, technology adoption, economic growth and government transformation. 
    • Build relationships across emerging government and innovation ecosystems outside London as government investment and decision-making continues to evolve. 
    • Represent Plexal at senior meetings, industry forums, conferences and government-facing events.
  • Partnerships & Growth Enablement
    • Develop strategic relationships with consultancies, technology providers, universities, ecosystem partners and delivery organisations. 
    • Build and shape consortium opportunities where partner-led approaches strengthen Plexal's position. 
    • Support priority bids, negotiations and commercial pursuits across the wider organisation. 
    • Share best practice across government sales, account development and opportunity shaping. 
    • Mentor and support colleagues across the commercial and delivery teams to strengthen capability and confidence.
  • KPIs and Commercial Outcomes
    • Significant £m pipeline generated and influenced across government markets. 
    • Material revenue secured through direct and partner-led opportunities. 
    • Number and quality of strategic opportunities shaped prior to procurement. 
    • Growth in multi-year and repeatable revenue opportunities. 
    • Conversion rate improvement across priority pursuits. 
    • Growth in partner-led opportunities and consortium wins. 
    • Strength and depth of senior relationships across government and strategic partners.
    • Contribution to Plexal's long-term positioning across government innovation, adoption and economic growth markets.


Your Skills

  • Commercially driven, outcome-focused and highly proactive. 
  • Naturally curious about government priorities, policy developments and market trends. 
  • Highly credible operating at senior levels across government and industry. 
  • Strong relationship builder with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups. 
  • Strategic thinker capable of translating insight into action. 
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping undefined opportunities. 
  • Collaborative and committed to enabling the success of others. 
  • Resilient, adaptable and able to thrive in fast-moving environments.


Your Experience

Essential:

  • Proven track record of selling into UK government and winning complex public sector opportunities. 
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 
  • Strong understanding of government procurement, commercial processes and public sector buying environments. 
  • Experience building relationships with senior government stakeholders. 
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies in complex environments.

description: What is Jedox? Jedox is a global leader in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and a recognized Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, helping organizations transform fragmented planning into connected, data-driven decision-making. Trusted by more than 2,500 customers worldwide, Jedox enables business planning, budgeting and forecasting for finance, sales, and broader enterprise departments with leading-edge technology to outperform digital transformation and provide tangible customer value. At the heart of the platform is JedoxAI - a multi-agent intelligence engine delivering explainable, AI-powered forecasting, natural-language insights and AIssisted™ planning - putting Jedox at the forefront of the shift to AI-driven performance management. Your Responsibilities As a Sales Account Executive (m/f/d) within the Jedox team, you will play a key part in helping enterprise customers to transform their planning, forecasting and performance management processes. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will use a value-based sales approach to show how Jedox provides modern, digital and integrated enterprise performance and analysis (xP&A) solutions. In this role, you will own the entire sales process for enterprise customers, from identifying potential clients to closing deals. You will promote Jedox as the ideal solution for xP&A initiatives, work closely with internal teams and develop long-term relationships with customers and partners, while maintaining a strong focus on value, trust and sustainable success. We are building a high-performing team defined by ownership, accountability and energy. This is a genuinely exciting time to join: AI is reshaping how every finance team plans and forecasts, and Jedox is right at the centre of that conversation - giving you a fresh, differentiated story to take to market. If you're a motivated seller who enjoys being out in front of customers and partners, and want to make your mark in an exciting company, you'll find real support, momentum and opportunity here. You will own your number, your territory and your pipeline - creating opportunity rather than waiting for it, with a team around you that celebrates the wins together. Own the end-to-end sales cycle: Generate revenue by adopting a value-selling approach throughout the process, from initial engagement to closing enterprise-level deals - with full personal accountability for every outcome in your territory. Create and own high-quality pipeline: Build and maintain healthy pipeline coverage against your quota through proactive, self-generated prospecting - not just inbound - with disciplined weekly pipeline management in our CRM as the single source of truth. Communicate the value of Jedox: Demonstrate how Jedox and JedoxAI empower xP&A projects and elevate planning, forecasting and business decisions - bringing AI-driven, explainable forecasting into the conversation and anchoring every discussion on business outcomes, not features. Inspire digital transformation: Engage prospects by presenting a clear and compelling vision of digitisation and integrated business planning. Develop strategic sales plans: Identify, prospect and execute targeted sales plays and activities to win enterprise customers, including structured account planning, rigorous qualification (e.g. MEDDPICC) and multi-threading across finance, IT and operations stakeholders. Cross-functional collaboration: Acquire new customers by working closely with the pre-sales, channel management, marketing and business development teams - bringing colleagues and partners in early, and lifting each other up as one team with one number. Drive market-facing activity: Contribute to workshops, webinars and events alongside marketing and partners to create demand and build visible expertise in your market. Work smarter with AI: Actively use modern AI tools in your daily workflow - from account research and prospecting to preparing presentations, proposals and follow-ups - so more of your time goes where it counts: in front of customers and partners. Own forecasting and pipeline management: Maintain accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts as well as pipeline reports, with strong CRM hygiene, and play an active role in prospecting activities. Build lasting relationships: Build trusted partnerships with customers, partners and internal stakeholders to ensure long-term success. Your Profile Over three years' experience in professional sales, ideally within the FP&A function. Experience in Enterprise Performance Management or in selling analytics, AI, data, or ERP solutions. Strong record of success in achieving and exceeding sales goals. Proven ability to build, manage and self-generate a healthy sales pipeline and expand existing accounts. A high-ownership mindset: you act with urgency, take responsibility for your results, and when challenges arise you come with ideas on how to tackle them together. Resilience and positivity: you're the kind of person who stays positive, keeps going and enjoys the journey as much as the win. A love of being active in the market: you genuinely enjoy talking to customers and partners - on calls, in meetings and at events - and you know that's where great pipeline comes from. Strong collaboration skills with a clear focus on customer success and innovation. Confident, hands-on use of AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar) in your day-to-day selling - for example researching accounts, building presentations and business cases, sharpening messaging and working smarter across the sales cycle. Native or fluent English skills; an established network and knowledge of the UK & Ireland enterprise market are a real advantage. Bookkeeper — Lab54

Location: London. All 3 days in office for the first three months. From month 4, 1 day per week remote once the agreed targets are being met.

Salary: £30–34k FTE equivalent, pro-rata (£18–20.5k at 3 days). Contract equivalent £150–200 per day.

Reports to: Financial Controller (interim: Managing Director)

Start: As soon as available

About Lab54

Lab54 is a content-led events and production company: [Anywhere But A Club.]

We create high-impact experiences in unexpected locations, capture them, and turn them into content. Combined global audience of 425,000+. We work with brands, record labels and artists — around 100 events a year across brand activations, artist pop-ups, hard-ticket shows, house parties and festival takeovers.

The role

The Bookkeeper is Lab54's day-to-day finance function: reconciliation, purchase-order matching, receipt capture, invoicing, debtor chasing and payroll preparation.

The defining feature of the job is that every pound has to land against an event. Lab54's core financial object isn't the month — it's the project. Each event carries a code (YYMM-Owner-Event-City) that runs from HubSpot through Xero, Teamwork and the purchase-order flow. Coding transactions to that project is not admin; it's the thing that makes per-event profitability computable. It is the single most important part of this role.

This role prepares, never approves. All payment runs are approved by the Managing Director, with the CEO approving above an agreed threshold.

Responsibilities

Purchase orders and supplier ledger

  • Match supplier invoices to their purchase order in Xero. This is a manual link, and it is the control that stops us paying more than we agreed.
  • Enforce the PO rule at the front door: any commitment of £500 or more needs a PO, and an invoice arriving without a PO number goes back to the supplier rather than into the ledger.
  • Prepare payment runs for approval. Nothing leaves the business without a bill, a PO and a sign-off.
  • Reconcile supplier statements monthly against our purchase ledger — the check that catches duplicate invoices and payments before they're made.
  • Maintain the purchase ledger and keep the aged creditor position accurate.

Reconciliation and coding

  • Bank and card reconciliations kept current within 48 hours, including Revolut Business card spend against Xero tracking categories.
  • Every reconciled line matched to a real source document. A line that reconciles without a bill behind it is an exception to raise, not a box to tick.
  • Code every transaction to the correct project code and tracking category. Chase the team when a code is missing rather than guessing one.
  • Keep the suspense and uncoded accounts at nil by month-end.
  • Produce a weekly untagged-spend report, by spender, and drive it to zero.

Receipts and VAT recovery

  • Chase and capture missing receipts to a 98% target. This is a cash exercise, not a filing one — every missing VAT invoice is input VAT we can't reclaim.
  • Flag transactions carrying no VAT treatment where the supplier is UK VAT-registered.
  • Prepare the VAT return workings for the external accountancy firm, who own submission.

Sales invoicing and debtors

  • Raise client invoices within 48 hours of the billing trigger, coded to the project.
  • Own debtor chasing end to end — a consistent cycle, escalated when it stalls, so nobody else in the business is carrying it.
  • Match incoming receipts to the right invoice and contact. Money that arrives against the wrong customer looks identical to money that never arrived.
  • Keep sales invoice sequencing clean — anything voided or reissued carries a recorded reason.

Project close

  • When a project closes, produce its final position: budgeted cost against actual cost, budgeted revenue against invoiced revenue, and the resulting margin.
  • Issue that to the CEO and Operations Director as a matter of routine. It is not a report anyone should have to request.
  • Late costs land after an event has finished — that's the nature of the business. The job is to make sure they land against the right project and that the closing number reflects them.

Cash and reporting

  • Produce a weekly cash one-pager: bank position, overdue debtors with days outstanding, payment runs due, projected balance.
  • Keep the company's master P&L model current — updating actuals and committed costs as they change, so the forecast reflects where the business genuinely is.
  • The model is ours; you update the numbers within it. Structural or formula changes come to the CEO first.

Payroll preparation

  • Prepare payroll data and submit it to the external payroll provider ahead of deadline.
  • Post the payroll journal to Xero each month. Wages must not sit in a control account.
  • Confirm the payroll account is funded before each run. This role does not execute payroll.

Close, deadlines and records

  • Run the monthly close to a published working-day deadline: accruals prepared with supporting detail, journals posted, period locked.
  • Every accrual carries a schedule — supplier, event, date of work. No balance we can't explain.
  • Maintain the statutory deadline register (VAT, PAYE, corporation tax, Companies House) and flag each one in advance. No filing sits invisibly in someone else's workflow.
  • Keep records orderly and audit-ready for the external accountancy firm.

What the first 90 days actually look like

We are being straight about this because we want someone who finds it interesting rather than alarming.

Lab54 has grown faster than its finance function, and we've recently changed accountants. The ledger carries a real backlog: untagged transactions across two financial years, unposted payroll journals, a month-end close that has not been run to a cadence, and a purchase-order process that has only just gone live. There is a documented correction schedule and an external FD working through it.

The first 90 days is a clean-up, not a steady state.

Days 31–60. Clear the untagged backlog. Take over sales invoicing, debtor chasing and received-payment matching. Payroll preparation and the monthly payroll journal move across.

Days 61–90. Run a full month close to deadline: suspense at nil, every accrual scheduled, supplier statements reconciled. Per-project cost data becomes reportable for the first time.

After that it becomes a genuinely well-defined job inside a documented control structure — and you'll have built it.

Clearing a backlog this size means asking people questions in real time — whose card that was, what the missing PO covers, which event a supplier belongs to. That's an hour of work in a room and a week of work over email. From month 4, one of the three days moves to remote, provided the measures below are being met.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Proven bookkeeping experience. Xero to a high standard is non-negotiable — tracking categories, purchase orders, bank rules, manual journals.
  • Purchase-order matching and supplier statement reconciliation as routine practice.
  • A project- or job-costing background — agency, events, production, construction, consultancy, anywhere the job rather than the month is the unit of profit. This is the part of the role we can't train quickly.
  • Strong reconciliation, coding and purchase-ledger discipline.
  • Experience preparing payroll data for an external provider and posting the payroll journal.
  • Comfortable working inside a defined control structure where you prepare and someone else approves.

  • Multi-currency invoicing and foreign supplier payments. We run events across Europe.

title: Finance Manager
description: We're Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi. The role Heidi's UK and Europe business is growing faster than the finance scaffolding underneath it. Central finance across Sydney, Melbourne and Manila runs month-end close, core accounting and day-to-day operations, but the region needs someone on the ground who owns the accuracy of its numbers and sits close enough to the commercial team to shape decisions before they get made. Today, regional leaders wait on Australian hours for answers about their own P&L. You'll end that. The role has two halves and both carry equal weight. You'll own regional financial control and compliance: the integrity of the balance sheet, the accuracy of management reporting and forecasts, cash, strong local controls, and statutory obligations across Companies House, HMRC and VAT, directed through external advisers. You'll also be a hands-on business partner to UK and Europe leadership, Sales and Customer Success, owning the P&L narrative, bringing a commercial view to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, and making sure teams see the financial consequence of the choices they make. You'll report to the Group Financial Controller with a dotted line to FP&A. What you'll do Financial reporting and month-end close Own the integrity of the UK&Europe balance sheet, with reconciliations that stay current, reviewed and explainable Own the accuracy of the UK&Europe monthly group reporting and management accounts with variance commentary that explains movements Be the single point of contact for group finance on anything UK&Europe: queries, adjustments, restatements, consolidation-level questions Compliance and risk oversight Own the UK&Europe compliance calendar (Companies House, HMRC, VAT) by directing external accountants and advisers Own the adviser relationships (accounting, tax, audit), keeping work well scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi's internal finance standards Build an early-warning process so compliance risk is caught and escalated well before it threatens trading status Be the accountable owner if something in the compliance chain breaks down Commercial business partnering Be the day-to-day finance partner to UK&Europe leadership, owning the regional P&L narrative, budget vs actual and the "why" behind the numbers Bring a commercial lens to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, flagging risk and opportunity early Translate regional performance into clear, decision-ready input for FP&A and company leadership Give UK&Europe business leaders a reliable, self-serve view of their numbers, so decisions stop waiting on Australian hours Feed central finance the regional inputs it needs at close: accrual estimates, revenue and spend context, then review and sign off on the UK&Europe result Revenue risk and collections Partner with Sales and Customer Success to resolve aged and disputed balances and unblock stuck revenue Own the commercial view of collection risk: which accounts, why, and what it means for cash, and feed it into forecasting Drive down UK&Europe DSO by fixing the upstream causes (contracting, disputes, process), not by chasing invoices FinOps, controls and performance frameworks Build the operating rhythm that turns UK&Europe finance from reactive support into a reliable performance framework: clear KPIs, owners, review cadences and escalation paths Partner with budget owners on spend decisions before they are made, rather than policing them after the fact Strengthen financial controls across spend, approvals, vendor onboarding, card usage, subscriptions and commercial commitments, while keeping the process pragmatic for a fast-moving region Review regional AP and card activity, including prompt removal of leaver access and cards, and escalate anomalies to central finance operations Partner with external accountants, tax advisers, compliance providers and other vendors, making sure work is well-scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi’s internal finance standards Use FinOps-style discipline to connect spend, usage and outcomes, especially across tooling, GTM systems, implementation costs and region-specific operating expenses Create simple documentation and control checks so the region can scale without relying on informal knowledge or one-off fixes What you'll need Strong commercial and financial acumen — comfortable moving between P&L narrative, deal economics and cash impact Experience business partnering with Sales, Customer Success or regional leadership in a growth business Track record improving collections or DSO by fixing root causes, not just process Experience owning spend or expense controls in a way that supports the business rather than only governing it Comfortable directing (not raw.title: Finance Manager
raw.description:
We're Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The role

Heidi's UK and Europe business is growing faster than the finance scaffolding underneath it. Central finance across Sydney, Melbourne and Manila runs month-end close, core accounting and day-to-day operations, but the region needs someone on the ground who owns the accuracy of its numbers and sits close enough to the commercial team to shape decisions before they get made. Today, regional leaders wait on Australian hours for answers about their own P&L. You'll end that.

The role has two halves and both carry equal weight. You'll own regional financial control and compliance: the integrity of the balance sheet, the accuracy of management reporting and forecasts, cash, strong local controls, and statutory obligations across Companies House, HMRC and VAT, directed through external advisers. You'll also be a hands-on business partner to UK and Europe leadership, Sales and Customer Success, owning the P&L narrative, bringing a commercial view to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, and making sure teams see the financial consequence of the choices they make. You'll report to the Group Financial Controller with a dotted line to FP&A.

What you'll do

Financial reporting and month-end close

  • Own the integrity of the UK&Europe balance sheet, with reconciliations that stay current, reviewed and explainable

  • Own the accuracy of the UK&Europe monthly group reporting and management accounts with variance commentary that explains movements

  • Be the single point of contact for group finance on anything UK&Europe: queries, adjustments, restatements, consolidation-level questions

Compliance and risk oversight

  • Own the UK&Europe compliance calendar (Companies House, HMRC, VAT) by directing external accountants and advisers

  • Own the adviser relationships (accounting, tax, audit), keeping work well scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi's internal finance standards

  • Build an early-warning process so compliance risk is caught and escalated well before it threatens trading status

  • Be the accountable owner if something in the compliance chain breaks down

Commercial business partnering

  • Be the day-to-day finance partner to UK&Europe leadership, owning the regional P&L narrative, budget vs actual and the "why" behind the numbers

  • Bring a commercial lens to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, flagging risk and opportunity early

  • Translate regional performance into clear, decision-ready input for FP&A and company leadership

  • Give UK&Europe business leaders a reliable, self-serve view of their numbers, so decisions stop waiting on Australian hours

  • Feed central finance the regional inputs it needs at close: accrual estimates, revenue and spend context, then review and sign off on the UK&Europe result

Revenue risk and collections

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to resolve aged and disputed balances and unblock stuck revenue

  • Own the commercial view of collection risk: which accounts, why, and what it means for cash, and feed it into forecasting

  • Drive down UK&Europe DSO by fixing the upstream causes (contracting, disputes, process), not by chasing invoices

FinOps, controls and performance frameworks

  • Build the operating rhythm that turns UK&Europe finance from reactive support into a reliable performance framework: clear KPIs, owners, review cadences and escalation paths

  • Partner with budget owners on spend decisions before they are made, rather than policing them after the fact

  • Strengthen financial controls across spend, approvals, vendor onboarding, card usage, subscriptions and commercial commitments, while keeping the process pragmatic for a fast-moving region

  • Review regional AP and card activity, including prompt removal of leaver access and cards, and escalate anomalies to central finance operations

  • Partner with external accountants, tax advisers, compliance providers and other vendors, making sure work is well-scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi’s internal finance standards

  • Use FinOps-style discipline to connect spend, usage and outcomes, especially across tooling, GTM systems, implementation costs and region-specific operating expenses

  • Create simple documentation and control checks so the region can scale without relying on informal knowledge or one-off fixes

What you'll need

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen — comfortable moving between P&L narrative, deal economics and cash impact

  • Experience business partnering with Sales, Customer Success or regional leadership in a growth business

  • Track record improving collections or DSO by fixing root causes, not just process

  • Experience owning spend or expense controls in a way that supports the business rather than only governing it

  • Comfortable directing (not necessarily performing) statutory compliance and VAT work through external advisers

  • High degree of autonomy and ownership in a small, remote-first global finance team

  • Clear, confident communicator — able to hold your own with commercial leaders and external advisers alike

  • Experience in a multi-entity or multi-currency business

Nice to have

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company

  • Qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent)

  • Exposure to Companies House, HMRC and Irish Revenue processes

  • Experience with Campfire, Airwallex or similar modern finance tooling

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You'll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who've felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we're building isn't always easy. But we didn't choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn't whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you're doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

title: Account Manager, Enterprise
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About the team The Enterprise Business team at Airwallex helps ambitious businesses operate globally by providing the financial infrastructure they need to manage payments, money movement and related financial operations. The Account Management team works strategically to maximise the enterprise customer-Airwallex partnership by building trust, identifying and driving new revenue streams, and ensuring operational success.. You will work alongside , Leadership, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations,Legal, GTM Partnerships, Customer Success, Finance and Revenue Strategy & Operations. The team operates with a high level of ownership and collaboration, managing complex customer needs and contributing directly to enterprise growth. What you’ll do As an Account Manager on the Enterprise team, you will manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers and help them maximise Airwallex value. You will build trusted relationships across commercial, finance, operations, product and technology stakeholders, while identifying opportunities to increase adoption, retain customers and expand their use of Airwallex’s products and markets. You will combine strategic account planning with hands-on ownership of upsells, , escalations, onboarding and complex customer initiatives. Working cross-functionally, you will turn customer insights into action and contribute to the growth of Airwallex’s Enterprise Business. This role is a quota-carrying commercial role and is based in London, UK. Responsibilities: Grow gross profit from existing customer accounts, manage customer operational success, and pursue upsell and expansion opportunities across Airwallex’s product suite. Build and execute strategic account plans, including customer objectives, stakeholder maps, risks, renewal plans and 12 to 18-month growth opportunities. Lead renewals, commercial negotiations, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, using data and customer insight to improve retention and drive Net Revenue Retention. Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and run effective business reviews that demonstrate value, address risks and align on future priorities. Coordinate complex customer initiatives across Sales, Product Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, KYC and Onboarding, Legal, Customer Success and other internal teams. Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity tracking and forecasts, while sharing customer feedback that can inform product, operational and go-to-market improvements. Who you are We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Minimum qualifications: 5 to 6 years of sales or account management experience, including experience managing complex enterprise or strategic customer relationships. A proven track record of retaining and growing existing accounts through renewals, upsell, cross-sell or other expansion motions. Experience managing multi-stakeholder customer relationships, including engagement with senior commercial, finance, operations, product or technology leaders. Strong commercial, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build trusted relationships internally and externally. description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p>CoreWeave’s Physical AI team is building the essential cloud platform for AI innovators, applying machine learning to solve previously intractable physics and engineering challenges. We operate at the intersection of advanced cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and applied data science, transforming how complex industrial products - such as automotive systems, aircraft, robotics, advanced manufacturing systems, and batteries - are conceived, tested, and developed.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Staff Product Manager, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one of the core components of our Physical AI platform. We're rebuilding the platform from the ground up, so you'll shape the product from day one. You'll drive execution across Research, Data Science, Engineering, and Forward Deployed Engineering to ship capabilities spanning agentic experiences, applied AI workflows, and enterprise integrations. You will work closely with enterprise customers to understand complex engineering and industrial workflows, identify where emerging AI technologies can create meaningful value, turn field signals into scalable platform improvements, and mentor other product managers across the organisation while setting a high bar for technical depth, product judgement, and customer empathy.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run discovery in the field, and spend time in front of customers</li> <li>Decide what we build. You’ll take a candidate product from problem to validated concept; use case, customer proof points, and the business case for continuing or stopping</li> <li>Ship products in a small squad, setting roadmap and sequencing work required.</li> <li>Keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned. For the products you own: a one-line pitch, short summary and demo that anyone in the company can follow - what it is, why we’re building it, what’s next.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Significant experience across product management, product strategy, technical programme leadership, or related roles, with a strong track record of turning complex technologies into products, platforms, or customer outcomes.</li> <li>High versatility with a proven ability to work across multiple technical domains, such as ML modelling, generative AI, agentic workflows, robotics, advanced manufacturing, cloud infrastructure, or data engineering.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency with the ability to confidently discuss APIs, architecture diagrams, <li>Absolute execution focus with a proven ability to build clarity out of ambiguity, move comfortably between strategy and hands-on delivery, maintain high attention to detail, and drive initiatives from concept through execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in engineering, physical research, robotics, advanced manufacturing, or applied data science, infrastructure platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or CoreWeave, and experience translating emerging technologies into real-world customer applications.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted coding or prototyping tools; our PMs are builders first and regularly use technology to explore ideas, validate concepts, and accelerate product development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit?</strong></p> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. We recognise that some of the strongest Physical AI product leaders have moved between product, engineering, research, strategy, programme leadership, and industry. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</p> <ul> <li><strong>You love to</strong> build clarity out of complexity and champion high-impact technical products from concept to launch.</li> <li><strong>You're curious about</strong> emerging Physical AI technologies, generative AI, agentic workflows, robotics, and how they can be applied to transform real-world industrial and engineering challenges.</li> <li><strong>You're an expert in</strong> cross-functional execution, seamlessly connecting the dots between deeply technical engineering and research teams, enterprise customers, and commercial priorities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h3> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Critical Illness Cover&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme&nbsp;</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What does the team work on?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">Roku's Automation support and Tools team focuses on providing innovative, impactful tools and SW solutions including AI enabled engineering capabilities to help accelerate validation efforts, improve efficiency, enhance productivity of all engineering team across Roku's entire embedded SW org. The team works across full-stack applications, backend services, and scalable platform services to improve developer productivity, end-to-end testing experience of Roku products and services. You will be joining a talented, high-performance team of developers with a strong delivery culture. We are looking for someone who can help us keep up this pace and continue delivering high quality as we grow.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What is the role?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">Roku is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Embedded Software Automation and Tools team to build full stack applications and services that support end-to-end automation and test infrastructure. This role involves designing and delivering full stack solutions that support cross-functional internal and external stakeholders across the Roku ecosystem. You will contribute across frontend and backend systems, with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. You will build and evolve APIs and microservices, and help integrate modern AI capabilities into production experiences where they add clear user value. The role requires strong technical judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to move from concept through delivery in a fast-paced environment.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">How will I use AI at Roku?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. We use AI agents and smart tooling across brainstorming, planning, analysis, and implementation. People set the direction, exercise judgment, and own the outcomes.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agentic frameworks — and can describe projects where you shipped real customer-facing work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, validate its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What are the responsibilities of the role?</span></h3> <ul class="list-inside list-disc whitespace-normal [li_&amp;]:pl-6"
