working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Accountant / Financial Reporting specialist to join our Finance Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

  • Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed.

  • Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process.

  • Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership.

  • Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate.

  • Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios.

  • Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments.

  • Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors.

  • A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency.

  • The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an "ownership mindset" and excellent judgment.

  • Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team

  • You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented

  • You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set and the day looks the same. That's the clearest reason this role doesn't work out for people

  • You need stable priorities. It's volatile here. Several topics run at once, progress depends on other people, and priorities can change overnight

  • You want to stay inside accounting. A large part of the job is working with teams outside Finance and with external advisors in each country

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 - 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the Audit Readiness initiative to drive impact in our year-end execution and documentation standards.

  • Collaborate with the Finance team to embed AI-forward ways of working, automating manual workflows to increase team capacity.

  • Grow your skills in process improvements and financial analysis, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale across our legal entity markets.

  • We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger leadership projects, mastering the intersection of AI and Finance, or deepening your expertise in complex consolidated reporting.

The location

This role is hybrid (on average, 3 days a week in the office) and can be located in either our Lisbon or Madrid office.

Show me the benefits!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring manager interview: A conversation with our Accounting Associate Director covering your technical accounting and IFRS experience.

  • Team panel and Pleo challenge: You'll meet the hiring manager, his manager and a peer from the team. The challenge is presented live in the session, so there's nothing to prepare or send in advance. We're looking at how you handle complexity, new areas and stakeholders.

  • Final interview: A closing conversation, used where it's helpful for both sides.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received a lot of applications but can only interview a finite number of people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

  • You're genuinely curious about fintech and how payments infrastructure actually works

  • You enjoy working with data and understanding systems, not just using them

  • You're excited by the responsibility of maintaining financial controls and regulatory compliance

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy improving processes and ways of working

  • You bring a self-starter attitude — you don't wait to be told what to do next

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You struggle working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities

  • You do not enjoy detailed analytical or investigative work

  • You prefer working in isolation rather than collaborating with colleagues across teams

  • You're not interested in the practical application of financial regulation

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Develop a strong understanding of Pleo's safeguarding obligations under FCA rules, including the CASS and DFSA safeguarding requirements. Learn how our reconciliation processes work across all our systems and develop expertise in carrying out and reviewing reconciliations

  • Collaborate with colleagues to help improve and streamline our reconciliation and reporting processes

  • Grow your skills in data handling, financial analysis, and audit preparation

  • Take on new challenges as you build confidence and the company continues to scale

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into process improvement leadership, or acquiring new skills in areas you identify for growth.

The location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background

  • Hiring Manager: A 45-minute chat with our Head of Safeguarding & Reconciliation

  • Pleo challenge: A 60-minute chat with peers and/or stakeholders to check how you would think and act in the role. Expect some real life examples as well as on the spot challenges

  • Final Interview: A 30-minute final chat with one of our senior stakeholders

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a significant number of applications but only a fraction were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn't make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Supply Planner
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>Anduril is seeking a Senior Supply Planner to join our team in Sydney, Australia. The Supply Chain team is responsible for planning and sourcing of materials to support rapidly iterating and building of cutting-edge defense hardware for autonomous underwater vehicles (AUV). You will have responsibility spanning the entire value chain from raw materials through finished goods and contributing to the strategic supply network development of Anduril’s product hardware, across their life cycles. You will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build.</p> <h3>WHAT YOU'LL DO:</h3> <ul> <li>Partner with design and manufacturing engineers to accelerate product development via activities such as:</li> <ul> <li>build bottom-up cost models, using supplier data and manufacturing insight to benchmark pricing and identify cost drivers</li> <li>rapidly align on build requirements, constraints, and feasibility against schedule</li> <li>Perform impact assessment on build schedule when change reviews are proposed and implemented</li> </ul> <li>Own and maintain the line of balance (LOB) for assigned programs, ensuring material availability is synchronised to the master build schedule. You'll be the connective tissue between procurement, production, and engineering — translating build requirements into actionable supply plans and driving resolution when gaps threaten schedule</li> <li>Drive and support clear-to-build (CTB) reviews ahead of each build phase, confirming all materials, long-lead items, and supplier deliverables are on hand or on track</li> <li>Collaborate with procurement to expedite, re-sequence, or source alternatives when supply risks emerge, escalating early with data-backed recommendations</li> <li>Track and report schedule adherence metrics (OTD, CTB pass rate, LOB health) and drive root cause analysis on misses.</li> <li>Maintain MRP/ERP system accuracy — planned orders, lead times, safety stock parameters, and demand signals aligned to current program baselines.</li> <li>Support all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle</li> <li>Support new product introduction (NPI) builds by developing initial supply plans from early-stage BOMs and engineering change orders.</li> </ul> <h3>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:</h3> <ul> <li>Ideally has background within:</li> <ul> <li>7+ years in supply planning, production planning, or materials management within a complex hardware manufacturing environment, preferably defence or aerospace.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing line of balance and clear-to-build processes across multi-level BOMs with long-lead and constrained materials.</li> <li>Track record of maintaining build schedule adherence in a rate production or NPI environment.Design &amp; development of electronics and/or mechanical devices</li> <li>Advanced supply planning experience, including stints in production planning, materials management, or master scheduling roles</li> </ul> <li>Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment</li> <li>Prior knowledge of Oracle or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field. Professional certifications such as CPIM, CSCP, or CPSM, or an advanced degree, are strongly preferred</li> <li>Eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Negative Vetting 2 security clearance (NV2)</li> </ul> <h3>Soft Skills and Leadership:</h3> <ul> <li>Strong communication skills — ability to present material risk and recovery plans to program managers and senior leadership with clarity and confidence.</li> <li>Comfort operating in ambiguity, particularly during early-stage programs where BOMs are evolving and requirements are fluid.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset with a bias for action — someone who chases answers rather than waiting for them.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335551550&quot;:0,&quot;335551620&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.&nbsp;</span><em><span data-contrast="auto">For more information, <a href="https://www.anduril.com/careers">Explore Our Benefits</a>.</span></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div class="RichText column1"> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams</strong></h3> <p class="detailElios">Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.</p> </div> <div class="RichText column2"> <p class="detailElios">To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:</p> <ul> <li> <p class="detailElios"><strong>No Financial Requests:&nbsp;</strong>Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.</p> </li> <li><strong>Please always verify communications:</strong> <ul> <li>Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will <em>only</em> come from an ----- address.</li> <li>Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to <a ---------- </ul> </li> <li> <p class="detailElios"><strong>Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:</strong>&nbsp;If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.</p> </li> <li> <p class="detailElios"><strong>What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:</strong>&nbsp;Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to&nbsp;<a ---------- Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.</p> </li> </ul> </div> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>Data Privacy</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit </span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink"><a href="https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/">https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/</a></span></span><span data-contrast="auto">.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335551550&quot;:0,&quot;335551620&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335551550&quot;:0,&quot;335551620&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Radio Frequency Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Group&nbsp;Overview</strong></h3> <p>Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&amp;C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts. Metrea specialises in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.</p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The Expeditionary Operations Lab, or EXOLAB, focuses on the rapid development, integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">evaluation</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and delivery of expeditionary capabilities within the Electromagnetic Warfare and Cyber domain.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">EXOLAB works across research and development, experimentation, prototyping, systems integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">trials</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and operational delivery. The team addresses complex customer problems by combining existing technologies, emerging </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">capabilities</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and internally developed solutions into deployable systems.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The lab </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">operates</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> across airborne, land, maritime and dismounted environments, with a strong emphasis on practical engineering, rapid learning and delivering systems that are operationally relevant, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">supportable</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and resilient.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW239653401 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a Principal RF Engineer to lead and support the research, design, development, integration and delivery of radio-frequency systems for expeditionary Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum operations and secure communications capabilities.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will be responsible for the RF engineering aspects of prototype and operational systems, including RF architecture, receiver and transmitter chains, antenna systems, signal distribution, filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, interference management and system performance analysis.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Principal RF Engineer will operate as a senior technical authority within a multidisciplinary team comprising electrical, systems, mechanical, software, cyber and operational specialists. The role will support the full engineering lifecycle, from concept development and technology evaluation through detailed design, integration, verification, trials, deployment and through-life support.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a practical, delivery-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between theoretical analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, prototype development, platform integration and field trials.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will be based either in Lincoln or London, with a longer-term intent to transition the primary location to London if hired initially in Lincoln.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Design, develop and integrate RF systems for expeditionary Unmanned Systems control, Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum-monitoring and secure communications capabilities.&nbsp;</span><span You would be working closely with engineering, manufacturing and procurement to make sure the right parts arrive when the build needs them.</p> <p class="_1xny9xl0 _1mqalmd1 _1mqalmd0 _1xny9xl1 _1xny9xlr _1mqalmd1 _1mqalmd0 _1kjlpc80">Our engineering builds and New Product Introduction programmes move at the pace of the parts that arrive. When a single long lead item slips, a build slot sits idle and the schedule behind it shifts. Today the picture of what is on order, what is late and what that does to the next build lives in several places at once, across MRP data, vendor conversations and spreadsheets. raw.description:
Mission

Airspeed is changing how revenue teams work. Our AI Revenue Orchestration Platform doesn't just analyze conversations — it acts on them. By turning every customer interaction into insight and action, Airspeed Agents help teams close gaps, move faster, and focus on what matters most: selling.

With 100+ SaaS customers and 90%+ adoption among reps, Airspeed is setting a new standard for execution at scale.

The Role

We're hiring a Finance & Operations Lead to build the financial and operational foundations that will support Airspeed's next stage of growth. You'll own our finance engine, company reporting, and core operating systems — helping make Airspeed easier to run and its decisions better.

This is a senior, hands-on role built for a high-performance operator who can move from financial modeling and board reporting to improving workflows and building scalable systems.

You'll report directly to the CEO and work closely with both founders and every functional leader.

This is not a conventional Chief of Staff, strategy-only, or back-office finance role. It's a builder-operator role for someone who takes full ownership of results and uses AI and automation to remove manual work wherever possible.

 

What You'll Own

 

Finance and Reporting:

  • Own the budget, rolling forecast, cash, runway, and scenario planning — giving leadership a clear, trusted view of the company's financial position and future needs.

  • Run a fast and accurate monthly close with our external accounting partners, and produce clear management and board reporting that explains what happened, why it happened, and what requires a decision.

  • Build a trusted view of ARR, bookings, retention, gross margin, burn, headcount, and unit economics, with clear definitions and reconciled data sources.

  • Oversee billing, collections, payroll coordination, expenses, procurement, and vendors, while putting practical controls in place to keep Airspeed ready for fundraising, audit, tax, and diligence.

     

AI, Automation, and Systems:

  • Make Airspeed AI-native in how we operate, not only in what we sell — redesigning recurring workflows with AI agents, automation tools, APIs, and lightweight code.

  • Build dependable operating systems with clean data, exception handling, audit trails, and human approval where needed, and create self-serve workflows that don't depend on you becoming the human router for every request.

  • Measure the impact of automation through speed, accuracy, reporting latency, and manual hours removed, while helping teams use AI safely with sensitive data and high-stakes decisions.

Company Operations:

  • Own the company operating cadence, including planning, KPI reviews, and decision follow-through, ensuring teams have clarity on priorities, ownership, and next steps.

  • Build scalable workflows for purchasing, contracts, onboarding, offboarding, access, and policies, and improve processes that cross team boundaries while keeping ownership clear.

  • Hold external partners and vendors accountable for scope, service, cost, and quality. Step into important gaps when needed, then fix the underlying system so they don't continue to depend on you.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership and the board trust the numbers and the forward forecast.

  • Close, reporting, forecasting, and planning run on a clear schedule with minimal manual chasing.

  • Core SaaS metrics have clear definitions and reconciled sources.

  • High-volume workflows are automated, monitored, and documented.

  • Airspeed can continue to grow without finance and operations headcount increasing with every layer of complexity.

 

Qualifications

  • Experience in finance, business operations, or a combined role at a scaling B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Hands-on ownership of planning, forecasting, management reporting, cash, runway, and board materials.

  • A track record of building operating systems, not simply administering existing processes.

  • Strong data and spreadsheet skills, with the ability to connect information across systems and identify when the underlying data can't be trusted.

  • An AI-native working style, with experience using AI to analyze, draft, reconcile, monitor, automate, and execute work.

  • Sound commercial judgment and exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues simply and challenge senior stakeholders when needed.

  • A bias for action: a high-ownership, low-ego operator who is comfortable moving between company-level questions and detailed execution.

  • Comfort working closely across Finance, Sales, Product, Engineering, and other functional teams in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in scale-up finance, finance transformation, consulting, or accounting followed by hands-on operating experience.

  • A professional accounting qualification.

  • Experience working with UK and US entities, subscription revenue, fundraising, or finance automation.

  • Experience at an early-stage startup or another lean, high-growth environment.

  • A passion for AI-native products, agent-driven workflows, and building smarter ways of working.

What We Value

  • Customer obsession and a relentless focus on measurable impact.

  • Team players who raise the bar and help scale processes and best practices.

  • Creative problem-solvers who can turn imperfect information into clear plans and results.

  • Operators who step into important gaps, solve the immediate problem, and then build systems that prevent it from recurring.

Why Join

  • Shape how the whole company operates.

  • Build an AI-native finance and operations function from the ground up.

  • Work directly with the founders and influence major company decisions.

  • Join an international SaaS company at a point where strong foundations can create outsized value.

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Security team within the Platform, Data & AI Security pillar, led by Maxime Lahaye, Senior Security Officer, based in Paris.

AI is fundamentally transforming how we work, and you'll join a team at the forefront of this evolution. This is your opportunity to build the GRC infrastructure of tomorrow, where automation, scripting, and security converge to enable Mirakl's next phase of growth.

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

 

Your Impact

1 · Compliance & Certifications — Automation-first

  • Contribute to maintaining Mirakl's ISO 27001, ISO 27018 and SOC 2 certifications, leveraging automated GRC platforms to enable continuous compliance monitoring
  • Automate evidence collection, control monitoring and documentation workflows using modern GRC tooling, AI-powered agents and scripting (Python, N8N)
  • Help manage and evolve the ISMS (Information Security Management System), ensuring it reflects both regulatory requirements and Mirakl's evolving AI-driven operations

2 · AI Governance 

  • Co-design and evolve Mirakl's AI usage governance framework: acceptable use policies, data classification for AI inputs, shadow AI detection and AI vendor risk assessment
  • Maintain a live inventory of AI tools used across the company and contribute to the risk-based process for evaluating and onboarding new tools
  • Monitor the AI governance regulatory landscape and help adapt Mirakl's framework proactively

3 · Security by design across all company projects

  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams early in project lifecycles to embed security and compliance requirements from the start
  • Participate in risk reviews across product and platform initiatives, with specific attention to AI-related threat vectors (prompt injection, data leakage in LLMs, access control for models)

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • Master's degree (Bac+5)
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in cybersecurity
  • You participated in ISO 27001 audit as a security contributor at least
  • Proven experience in scripting and automation (Python, N8N or equivalent)
  • Experience in a consulting firm or technology company is a plus
  • Strong understanding of compliance frameworks and security standards

Skills:

  • Strong technical profile with hands-on experience developing scripts and automating processes
  • Proactive and autonomous, with strong organizational and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent communication skills to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Integrity and ethics as core values
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
  • Experience with web application and cloud (SaaS) security is a plus

Tools Used

  • Python
  • N8N
  • Drata
  • AWS, GCP
  • Office Suite / Google Workspace

Languages

  • Fluent in French and conversational English

title: Supply Chain Quality Engineer - MAIT
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. The holder of this position will have duties towards the development of suppliers and support to the Manufacturing, Assembly, Integration and test function. Key Responsibilities: In the Supply Chain Quality area Provide inputs for Supplier / Subcontractor quality requirements for Proposals, and Contracts. Perform surveillance activities of contract execution for what it pertains Quality Aspects. Engage with Suppliers /. Subcontractors on the resolution of Non conformances Participate and contribute in contracted Quality and Engineering gates. Accept subcontracted products and deliverables through the participation of Delivery Review Boards and the provision of certificates of acceptance. In the MAIT Quality Area Planning & Execution of Quality Inspections: In collaboration with the MAIT and Product Assurance team, define and execute inspection control activities at: Incoming Key stages of manufacturing, assembly, integration & testing. Before release to customers or next integration phase. Nonconformance Management Support the detection, documentation and containment of nonconformances. Assist in Material Review Board (MRB) activities and follow up on rework or repair implementation and verification. Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive actions in coordination with engineering and MAIT. Quality Assurance support in MAIT Operations: Provide day-to-day quality support to MAIT. Review and approve MAIT procedures. Monitor and enforce compliance with internal procedures, customer requirements, space and aerospace quality standards (e.g., AS9100). Qualification of Special processes based in EN9100 (e.g: welding, Non-Destructive Testing, etc). Desirable experience with welding. Train MAIT staff on quality procedures and best practices. Calibration coordination. Continuous Improvement: Lead quality improvement projects to enhance process stability and product quality. Collaborate with design, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to improve product quality. Analyze quality data and generate reports to track trends and identify areas for improvement. Required Skills & Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in a quality assurance role, preferably in aerospace, space, defense, or other high-reliability manufacturing environments. Knowledge of quality standards (e.g., EN/AS9100, ISO 9001). Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, inspection techniques (visual, dimensional, electrical), and GD&T. Experience with nonconformance management systems and root cause analysis tools (e.g., 8D, 5-Whys, Ishikawa). Proficiency in quality tools such as FMEA, control plans, and statistical analysis. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and desirable experience with Power BI or similar data visualization tools. Ability to work cross-functionally in a dynamic environment. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable. All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible. If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc. raw.title: Director, Business Development
raw.description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

  • Experience selling , multi-service solutions to corporate clients — ideally in one or more of the following: creative services, digital production, marketing services, SaaS/tech, or professional services

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

  • Experience navigating large organisations — identifying budget holders, managing procurement processes, and building internal champions

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Ability to sell both transactional and strategic engagements depending on client maturity

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

  • Comfortable discussing technology, AI, and workflow solutions as well as creative services

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in both French and English

  • Commercially rigorous — accurate pipeline management, disciplined forecasting

 

Languages

  • French — native or bilingual (essential)

  • English — fluent, business-level (essential)

  • Additional languages a plus

 

Education

  • Degree in **Business, Marketing, Communications, Languages, or a creative discipline** — or equivalent professional experience

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. Applicants with disabilities are welcome and encouraged. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: About Payflows At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it. But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool. We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤 Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter. That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform , where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control. We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized. We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters. In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future. Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗 🚀 What you’ll actually do You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day. For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved. In a typical week, you might: Design and implement new services for a product feature. Refactor an early service to make it more robust. Investigate a performance or production issue. Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature. Review code and help teammates improve. Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations. Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them. Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists . Both matter. You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production. You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time. 💻 Our current tech reality Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏 Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools. Core language: Python Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic Data: PostgreSQL Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense Performance: some Rust for critical paths Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in. Over the next year, we’ll focus on: Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents Simplifying services Improving tests and observability Making performance more predictable Cleaning up early code We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step. ✨ Who’s going to thrive with us You’ll probably feel comfortable here if: You like building products people actually use. You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship. You take initiative and lead by example. You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out. You’re pragmatic about trade-offs. You communicate with kindness and clarity. This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of: Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans. Designing reliable, safe automation in production. Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly. You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖 🧩 What you’ll get from this role Real ownership over parts of the system. Direct impact on customers and product decisions. A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝 A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements. Exposure to real scaling and production challenges. The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside. We offer: Competitive salary and equity. Flexible remote setup (we only ask you to be at the office the first 3 days of each month). A high-autonomy environment where you have real ownership and space to make an impact. Plenty of room to grow, take responsibility, and shape parts of the product. A culture based on trust, ownership, and clear communication. This isn’t a huge corporate environment. In exchange, you get autonomy, responsibility, and the chance to shape a product that’s still early in its story—and help build what finance operations will look like in the next decade 🚀 Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About Payflows

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

  • Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

  • Investigate a performance or production issue.

  • Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

  • Review code and help teammates improve.

  • Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

  • Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools.

  • Core language: Python

  • Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic

  • Data: PostgreSQL

  • Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense

  • Performance: some Rust for critical paths

  • Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in.

Over the next year, we’ll focus on:

  • Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents

  • Simplifying services

  • Improving tests and observability

  • Making performance more predictable

  • Cleaning up early code

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step.


✨ Who’s going to thrive with us

  • In a typical week, you might:

    • Evolve our infrastructure-as-code to add a service, a queue, or a whole new environment.

    • Improve our CI/CD pipelines so engineers ship safely and fast, dozens of times a day.

    • Investigate a production issue: a latency spike, a failing deploy, a database under load.

    • Strengthen observability with dashboards, alerts, and traces, so we catch problems before customers do.

    • Harden our security, secrets management, and access controls.

    • Tune cost and performance across our AWS footprint.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools

We're an AWS shop, and we lean on managed services and infrastructure-as-code so the system is reproducible and easy to reason with. A growing part of our world is making the backend a set of reliable, deterministic tools that AI agents can call, which raises the bar on reliability even further.

  • Infra-as-code: Pulumi (Python)

  • Compute: ECS + Lambda, serverless when it makes sense

  • Data: PostgreSQL on RDS/Aurora

  • CI/CD: GitLab CI

  • Orchestration: Airflow (MWAA)

  • Observability: Grafana Cloud, CloudWatch, Sentry

  • Auth & identity: Cognito, IAM

  • Edge & frontend: API Gateway, ALB, AWS Amplify for the web app

title: Chief of Staff / Business Ops
description: Global supply chains move 80% of world trade and almost none of it accounts for its climate impact. Searoutes builds the data infrastructure that lets freight forwarders, shippers, and carriers measure and cut their CO2 footprint. We're a ~20-person SaaS team headquartered between Marseille and Nice, backed by Breakthrough (a US venture platform), and growing fast with enterprise logistics clients across the globe. We're looking for a  Chief of Staff  to become the CEO's right hand and the operational engine of the company as we scale, someone who thrives on turning strategic priorities into flawless execution, and who wants a front-row seat (and real influence) on how a European climate-tech scale-up is built. WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT Direct line to the top.  You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the CEO and sit in the room for every major decision, no layers, no filters. Real scope, real ownership.  This isn't a coordination-only or admin-only role. You'll own the board rhythm, shape internal reporting, and run special projects end-to-end. Global supply chains move 80% of world trade and almost none of it accounts for its climate impact. Searoutes builds the data infrastructure that lets freight forwarders, shippers, and carriers measure and cut their CO2 footprint. We're a ~20-person SaaS team headquartered between Marseille and Nice, backed by Breakthrough (a US venture platform), and growing fast with enterprise logistics clients across the globe.

We're looking for a Chief of Staff to become the CEO's right hand and the operational engine of the company as we scale, someone who thrives on turning strategic priorities into flawless execution, and who wants a front-row seat (and real influence) on how a European climate-tech scale-up is built.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

  • Direct line to the top. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the CEO and sit in the room for every major decision, no layers, no filters.
  • Real scope, real ownership. This isn't a coordination-only or admin-only role. You'll own the board rhythm, shape internal reporting, and run special projects end-to-end.
  • A bridge between two worlds. You'll be the connective tissue between a lean European startup and a US shareholder, a rare vantage point most operators only get years into their career.
  • Impact you can see. With ~20 people, your work doesn't get lost in a hierarchy. What you fix, ships. What you build, gets used.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Board & shareholder rhythm Own the full cadence with our shareholders:  board decks, pre-reads, action tracking, and follow-through, so nothing slips between meetings
  • Leadership operating system Run the agenda, follow-ups, and accountability loop for leadership meetings. The person who makes sure decisions turn into action, not just notes.
  • Reporting & analytics Build and maintain pipeline dashboards (HubSpot), KPI tracking, and management/investor reporting that leadership actually relies on.
  • CEO partnership Support the CEO on communications, meeting prep, and represent them in operational forums when needed.
  • Special projects Lead cross-functional initiative:  process improvements, tool rollouts, scaling projects with real autonomy to design and execute.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years in business operations, strategy consulting, or a Chief of Staff–type role, SaaS or logistics/supply chain experience is a strong plus
  • A builder's mindset: organized, detail-obsessed, and allergic to dropped balls
  • Comfort with data: HubSpot, spreadsheets, dashboards, and slide decks are your natural habitat
  • Fluent French and English, written and spoken
  • Genuine ease working across cultures, you'll be in daily contact with US-based teams
  • A proactive streak: you spot what's needed before anyone has to ask
  • Startup energy,  you're energized by ambiguity, not slowed by it

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience working with US shareholders or inside a subsidiary structure
  • Familiarity with Notion, PandaDoc, Basecamp, or HubSpot
  • A genuine interest in sustainability, logistics, or the maritime industry
  • Experience helping a company professionalize through a scaling phase

Benefits

  • A high-impact seat at the leadership table, from day one
  • Exposure to both European startup culture and US corporate governance
  • A fast-paced, no-BS environment; your work matters immediately, not eventually
  • Competitive fixed salary + performance bonus
  • Mutuelle, and standard French benefits (Syntec collective agreement)
  • Two company-wide offsites a year
  • A mission worth showing up for: helping decarbonize global trade

title: Language Lead - French (Contract)
description: About Cartesia Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do. We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences. We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI. Overview We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French. This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language. This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support. About the Engagement You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include: Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel. Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects. Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric. Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations. Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language. Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases. Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators. Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time. Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators. Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes. Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team. Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes. Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Commitment Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected. Requirements Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France. Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance. Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines. Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English. Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators. Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates. Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight. Preferred Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics. Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators. Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT. Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs. Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

     

Commitment

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

 

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.
